en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide cobblestone market square lined with 2–3‑storey houses with steep gabled roofs. A group of people, including children, stand in the center of the square, while others walk along the sides. Over the distant end of the square rises a church or town‑hall tower with a distinctive tall spire and a figure or weather vane on top. On one of the left-hand buildings the sign 'Im Anker' is visible, suggesting an inn or guesthouse. The atmosphere and clothing suggest an early‑20th‑century European town scene.
